rv.q: Ayckbourn's comic masterwork receives a sterling revival that captures both the playwright's surgical wit and his underlying compassion for his flawed characters.
What emerges is a portrait of sexual frustration and romantic delusion so comprehensive and convincing that you feel as if you've been living with these people for years.
The Theatre Company gives the tri-part event an engaging revival, returning it to Broadway after 35 years.

cn.t: Ayckbourn's comic masterwork gets a sterling revival that captures both surgical wit and deep compassion, creating a comprehensive portrait of romantic delusion so convincing it feels like living with these characters for years.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
